title: ship horn
author: monotraum
changes: A real ship's horn going 'toot… toooot' across a seaport (no tugboat recording was available, so the closest genuine boat horn). Trimmed to 3.00–5.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
